days.title: Central Villages and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nebel
stops.detail: Nebel, located on the mudflat side, is today the largest village on the island.

stops.name: St.-Clemens-Kirche
stops.detail: The first houses of this new settlement clustered around St. Clemens Church, which had previously stood in the open field between Norddorf and Süddorf for two centuries.

stops.name: Steenodde
stops.detail: Steenodde, also a district of Nebel and located on the mudflat side, was for many years the island's only port until Wittdün replaced it as the most important ferry port.

stops.name: Wittdün
stops.detail: The North Sea spa Wittdün is located at the southern tip of the island and is most significantly shaped by tourism.

stops.name: Amrumer Leuchtturm
stops.detail: The striking Amrum Lighthouse stands here, a few hundred meters west of the village of Wittdün.

stops.name: Norddorf
stops.detail: The northernmost place on the island is the North Sea spa Norddorf.

stops.name: A Siatler
stops.detail: The highest elevation is the dune A Siatler (German: Setzerdüne) at 32 meters above sea level.

stops.name: Amrum-Odde
stops.detail: In the extreme northeast of the island lies the Amrum-Odde, which has not yet benefited from the development of the Kniepsand.
